description: List calendar events in a date range, filterable by user or calendar. If contact_id is given, all events attached to that contact are returned and other filters are ignored. LACRM: GetEvents.

calendar_ids.description: Only events on these CalendarIds (your own calendars only).

contact_id.description: Only events attached to this contact (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

end_date.description: End of the range (inclusive), ISO 8601 date or date-time.

start_date.description: Start of the range (inclusive), ISO 8601 date or date-time.

name: lacrm_list_events
title: List calendar events
